## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution in a few sentences.

## Related issue

Link the related issue, for example `Closes #123`, or explain why no issue is needed.

## Changes

- Describe the important changes.
- Call out user-visible behavior and architectural decisions.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks used to validate the change.

```text
pnpm run check
```

Tested platforms:

- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Not platform-specific

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before and after visuals for interface changes. Write `Not applicable` otherwise.

## Security and privacy

Describe any impact on permissions, filesystem access, process execution, stored data, network access, GitHub Actions, or release artifacts. Write `No impact` when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to the relevant issue when appropriate.
- [ ] Code and comments are written in English.
- [ ] Comments are included only where necessary.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where necessary.
- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes locally, or any limitation is explained above.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, logs, local databases, or generated build artifacts are included.
- [ ] I have read and agree to follow the Code of Conduct.
